glosses: shot; gunshot (the result of launching a projectile or bullet)
range (the distance from a person or sensor to an object)

examples.text: Tom dijo que escuchó tres tiros esa noche.
examples.en: Tom said he heard three gunshots that night.
Did anyone hear the gun shot?

examples.text: Así mato dos pájaros de un tiro.
examples.en: That way I kill two birds with one stone.
